answer: Standing here behaves like an ember: tend it nightly or it cools. Any account that signs no real action within an epoch window loses half its weight, and climbing back to the oasis it once pooled takes as many live epochs as it slept - no batch path, no shortcut. So a farmer's lagoon of ten thousand keys demands ten thousand separate nightly tendings. Dormancy, our most honest habit, is the one a sybil farm cannot afford.
